case.summary: Investigation HHG-015 was initiated after online transaction 3464869 for $599.94 on card C03042-K1 was flagged due to a risk score of 0.77 and a previously unseen device profile. Upon outreach, customer C03042 confirmed the purchase and verified the new device. Consistent with eight cleared historical episodes sharing similar fingerprints, the alert was resolved as legitimate.
